promptDoing:
Please keep advancing the following in-progress task; when finished, move it to the test lane with `cicy-todo test {{id}}` (awaiting review — don't mark it done yourself):

{{title}}
alignPrompt:
Please reconcile the current todo progress (data lives in `<workspace>/.cicy/todos.yaml`, operated via `cicy-todo`):

1. First run `cicy-todo list --all` to fetch the full list.
2. Completed: `cicy-todo done <id>`
3. No longer needed: `cicy-todo drop <id>`
4. Unfinished: judge by current state, split or adjust.

Report one line when done: N completed / N adjusted / N added.
assignTooltip: Assign to a worker (hand off & send)
